title: The Judges
intro: From the entry into Canaan to Israel’s first king. The dated events are on the lower row.
note: The judges are shown in the Bible’s order, evenly spaced. The Bible does not give their dates, and some served at the same time in different parts of the land.

items.name: Samuel
items.when: Prophet and judge · date not given
items.text: Samuel kept judging Israel all the days of his life. He is not usually counted among the twelve judges. In 1117 B.C.E. he anointed Saul as Israel’s first king.

items.name: Israel enters Canaan
items.text: Under Joshua the nation crosses the Jordan.

items.name: Major conquest completed
items.text: The main conquest of the land is finished and it is divided among the tribes.

items.name: Joshua dies
items.text: Joshua completes his book and dies. The period of the judges, as usually viewed, begins with Othniel sometime afterward.
items.sources: si Study 3, chart of dates; it “Judge”

items.name: Ruth and Naomi
items.when: In the days of the judges
items.text: The events of the book of Ruth cover about eleven years of the judges’ rule. No date is given.
items.sources: nwt Table of the Books of the Bible
items.approx: No date is given. It is placed in the period only to show that it belongs to these years.

items.name: Samuel anoints Saul as king
items.text: Israel asks for a king and the period of the judges ends.
